fixes.explanation: Good thought, friend, but that's not the one. Peter says no prophecy of Scripture comes from "…one’s own interpretation." (2 Peter 1:20) He never mentions elders here. The next verse says no such prophecy was ever "…brought forth by the will of man…" but "…men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit." (2 Peter 1:21) So the source isn't human will at all, it's God by the Holy Spirit.

problems.problem: The explanation says elders' teaching is a person's teaching, but does not explain how teaching from elders differs from one's own interpretation.
